The '''Tourist Center''' was located in [[Tasariq City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. Run by the [[Imperial Ministry of Tourism]], the Tourist Center provided information on the planet to visitors, along with arranging tours and vacation activities for those interested.<ref name="J15" />
